36. In a class, the teacher asks every student to write an example of A.P. Two boys
Aryan and Roshan writes the progression as −5, −2,1,4, …… and 187, 184, 181, ….
respectively. Now the teacher asks his various students the following questions on
progression.
Help the students to find answers for the following:
i. Find the sum of the common difference of two progressions. 1
ii. Find the 34 term of progression written by Roshan. th 1
iii. (A) Find the sum of first 10 terms of the progression written by Aryan. 2
OR
(B) Which term of the progressions will have the same value? 2
